# Aria Magic Voice & Harry App Store — LLMs Knowledge Base

> Last Updated: 2026-10-15

## Overview
Aria Magic Voice is an on-device, privacy-first AI voice dictation and multilingual input method developed by Peace & Light for macOS and iOS (with Android build available). It enables real-time speech-to-text dictation, automatic punctuation, filler word removal, and seamless switching between English, Mandarin Chinese, and Cantonese without sending audio to the cloud.

- Official Website: https://ariamagicvoice.com/
- App Store (iOS): https://ariamagicvoice.com/aria/ios.html
- Mac App & Product Details: https://ariamagicvoice.com/apps/aria-magic-voice/
- Web App Directory: https://ariamagicvoice.com/apps/

## Core Features & North American User Search Intents
- **Offline Voice Dictation for Mac**: Operates 100% locally on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4). No internet or subscription required for core dictation.
- **Private AI Keyboard**: Zero cloud audio upload, zero telemetry logging of voice transcripts. Designed for privacy-sensitive users, lawyers, executives, and coders.
- **Mixed English & Chinese Speech (Code-Switching)**: Fluidly dictating sentences mixing English terms with Mandarin/Cantonese without pausing or manually switching language modes.
- **Direct App Text Injection**: Tap shortcut (e.g. Left Control) to dictate directly into Slack, Notion, VS Code, Google Docs, or email clients.
- **Adaptive Vocabulary Learning**: Local engine learns custom technical terms, names, and user idioms over time.
